description: 국토안전관리원_특수교량 계측 관리기준 데이터 서비스 [roads, bridges and tunnels] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 국토안전관리원. 특수교량의 안전 상태를 실시간으로 모니터링하고, 계측값의 기준치를 초과한 이상신호를 감지하여 제공합니다. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 국토안전관리원. Its tags are 안전, 이상신호, 트리거, 모니터링, 위험관리. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2026-09-15 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
